item.title: Apparix E-Commerce Platform

item.title: PayPal Payment Plugin
item.description: Accept PayPal Payments in Your Apparix Store The PayPal Payment Plugin integrates PayPal Commerce Platform with your Apparix store, allowing customers to pay using PayPal, Pay Later, Venmo, and credit/debit cards. Key Features PayPal Checkout - Accept payments from millions of PayPal users worldwide Pay Later Options - Offer Pay in 4 and PayPal Credit to increase conversions Venmo Support - Accept Venmo payments (US customers only) Credit/Debit Cards - Process cards directly through PayPal Multi-Currency Support - Accept 12 major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, NZD, MXN, BRL, SEK, NOK) Webhook Signature Verification - Secure payment confirmations with PayPal webhook signature validation Automatic Retries - Built-in retry logic with exponential backoff for reliable API calls Connection Testing - Verify your API credentials are working before going live Sandbox Mode - Test payments safely before accepting real transactions Requirements Apparix 1.0.0 or higher PHP 8.1 or higher PayPal Business Account PayPal REST API credentials (Client ID and Secret) Installation Download and extract the plugin to /content/plugins/paypal/ Activate the plugin in Admin > Plugins Configure your PayPal API credentials from developer.paypal.com Set up webhooks in PayPal Developer Dashboard and add Webhook ID for security Test in sandbox mode before going live What's New in v1.1.0 Webhook signature verification for enhanced security Multi-currency support (12 currencies) Connection testing to validate API credentials Retry logic with exponential backoff Improved error handling and logging Customizable funding source options

item.title: Etsy Sync Plugin
item.description: Sell on Etsy from Your Apparix Store The Etsy Sync Plugin connects your Apparix store with your Etsy shop using the modern Open API v3, allowing you to manage your handmade business from one central location. Key Features Full Listing Sync - Create and update Etsy listings directly from Apparix Image Upload - Automatically upload product images to Etsy (up to 10 per listing) Real-Time Inventory - Keep stock levels synced across channels automatically Order Import - Pull Etsy orders into Apparix with full transaction details Connection Testing - Verify your credentials work before syncing Link Existing Listings - Connect products to existing Etsy listings Rate Limiting - Built-in protection against API throttling (10 QPS limit) Auto Token Refresh - OAuth tokens automatically refresh when expired Draft or Active - Create listings as drafts or publish immediately Tags Support - Sync product keywords as Etsy tags (up to 13) Listing Options Who Made - I did, Someone else, or A member of my shop When Made - Made to order, or specific date ranges (2020-2025, vintage, etc.) Category - Set default taxonomy ID for your products Shipping Profile - Assign your shop shipping profiles to new listings Return Policy - Assign return policies to new listings Shop Sections - Organize listings into shop sections Required OAuth Scopes listings_r, listings_w, listings_d (listing management) transactions_r (order/receipt access) shops_r, profile_r (shop information) Requirements Apparix 1.0.0 or higher Etsy Seller Account Etsy Developer App (free at etsy.com/developers) OAuth tokens from authorization flow PHP 8.1+ Getting Started Create an app at etsy.com/developers Complete the OAuth authorization flow to get tokens Install the plugin and enter your API credentials Configure your shipping profile and return policy IDs Start syncing products! Version 1.1.0 - Now with image uploads, rate limiting, connection testing, link existing listings, and full order import with line items.

item.title: Apparix Backup Plugin
item.description: Full Backup Solution with Cloud Storage The Apparix Backup Plugin provides comprehensive data protection with Backblaze B2 cloud storage, tiered backup levels, encrypted .env files, and health notifications. Available on all editions u2014 including the free tier. What's New in v2.0 Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage u2014 Upload backups to the cloud with 10 GB free storage. One-click upload, download, and delete from your admin panel. 3 Backup Tiers u2014 Essential (free), Standard (Professional+), and Complete (Enterprise+). Each tier adds more to your backup. Encrypted .env Backup u2014 Your .env file is backed up with AES-256-CBC encryption, protecting sensitive credentials. Health Notifications u2014 Dashboard warnings for stale backups, cloud upload failures, low disk space, and errors. Size Estimates u2014 See estimated backup size per tier before creating a backup. Backup Tiers Essential (Free)Standard (Pro+)Complete (Enterprise+) Database.env (encrypted)Themes & pluginsEverything in Essential +Product imagesUser uploadsEverything in Standard +Full application codeConfig exports (JSON) Key Features Backblaze B2 Integration u2014 S3-compatible cloud storage with auto-upload and retention policies Database Streaming Export u2014 Memory-efficient chunked exports that won't overwhelm your server Auto-Upload to Cloud u2014 Backups can be automatically sent to B2 after creation Automatic Retention u2014 Separate retention policies for local and cloud backups Scheduled Backups u2014 Hourly, daily, or weekly automatic backups via cron One-Click Manual Backup u2014 Create instant backups from the admin panel Cloud Management u2014 Upload, download, and delete cloud backups from the admin panel Dashboard Alerts u2014 Backup health warnings appear right on your dashboard Backblaze B2 Free Tier Backblaze offers 10 GB free storage and 1 GB/day free downloads u2014 no credit card required. Sign up directly from the plugin settings page. Requirements Apparix 1.0.0 or higher PHP 8.1 or higher PHP ZipArchive and cURL extensions
